messages:
Alex K: Heads up — seeing ~6% of inbound HubSpot leads hit unassigned in the EMEA round-robin after enrichment lag. Spike started ~08:15 UTC. HubSpot webhook shows 504s.
Maya P: ugh. Is this the enrichment timeout we saw last week? See runbook: https://go/runbook/inbound 
Samir R: yep, looks like enrichment debounce + RR assignment race. When enrichment webhook returns late, the HubSpot workflow requeues and RR slot is skipped. :thinking_face: 
Alex K: can we do a short-term patch to assign to fallback owner within 30s? Prefer not to change RR rules permanently.
Olivia (ops): we can add a fallback_owner on the webhook mux. Quick patch: set default_owner = 'marketing-inbound' if enrichment not present after 25s. Will that keep fairness? :shrug: 
Maya P: sounds ok as temp. Add logging so we can revert. Also need a test for timezone-aware owners (EMEA shifts).
Samir R: sample patch snippet:
```
if (!enrichment || enrichment.age > 25s) {
  lead.owner = FALLBACK_OWNER
  lead.meta.assigned_by = 'fallback-patch-2023-11-30'
}
```
Maya P: also add HubSpot property `ri_assign_state` to track fallback reason (values: rr, fallback, manual).
HubSpot Bot: webhook 504 -> /workflows/v2/assign (count=42, last=1698743190)
Alex K: thx bot. Can we do a canary: enable fallback for EMEA for 1 hour then roll back? Need ops OK.
Olivia (ops): can do. Plan: deploy patch to staging -> enable EMEA flag on prod for 60m -> monitor metrics: unassigned_rate, average_assign_latency, claim-failures. Will run at 10:00 UTC to hit morning EMEA.
Samir R: metric thresholds: unassigned_rate > 1.5% alert, avg_assign_latency > 12s alert, rr_skips > 0.5% paging.
Maya P: add a short playbook entry in marketing ops: who to page (oncall SDR, ops), how to rollback (flip feature flag), and notify #salesops.
Alex K: also need SF mapping change? If fallback owner is external queue, ensure SF lead owner sync map doesn't create duplicates.
Samir R: good catch. Add mapping rule: if hubspot.owner == 'marketing-inbound' set SF.owner = 'Inbound Queue' (queue id 12345) and do not create owner history event.
Olivia (ops): I'll add to deploy checklist. ETA for canary: 45m. Anyone object?
Maya P: :+1: do it. Add me to notify list.
Alex K: fine. I'll create the playbook snippet and update the HubSpot workflow doc.
Maya P: small follow-up — let's also add a scheduled job to scan leads stuck in enrichment > 5m and mark for manual review.
Alex K: agreed. Good triage. I'll post a post-mortem if we see > 1% unassigned after canary.
Olivia (ops): deploying patch to staging now. ping here when you enable flag.
Samir R: logs: staging assign latency baseline 8.2s -> with fallback enabled 6.1s (fewer retries). Keep an eye on fairness metrics.
Alex K: nice. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
